verdict.rationale: Unreal publishes API reference documentation, including Remote Control HTTP and WebSocket API references and Python editor-scripting docs, and agents can fetch these pages keylessly. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or has runnable, try-it-in-browser examples. The docs are served as an HTML SPA shell rather than markdown. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer, runnable or live examples embedded in the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration of any interactive docs experience.
